context: One small PR (or two: code vs docs). Nothing here changes gate verdicts; anything that grows behavioral splits out.
description:
Itemized P3 findings from the 2026-07-21 adversarial UAT review, batched because each is small and none changes gate behavior:

(a) enumerate double-count: tests/uat/phases/enumerate.py:119-138 adds a (missing-platform x missing-benchmark) cell to BOTH accounting buckets, contradicting the single-bucket contract in report.py:242-247; reproduced live (2 rows for 1 cell). Introduced by #1238.
(b) doc drift: docs/operations/uat-framework.md:404 still says startup-failed platforms' cells are 'recorded as skipped-unreachable'; since the fail-advance split they land in the separate startup_failed accounting (execute.py:104-107, cells_io.py:61,105).
(c) spec drift: _project/specs/uat-framework.md Section 3 says free_space_min_gib <= 0 is a validation error; config.py:270-281 deliberately accepts 0 as the documented disk-gate opt-out.
(d) stale docstring: benchbox/core/expected_results/tpch_results.py:14,40 claims seed 0o0101000000 = '16843008 decimal' (hex misreading); actual value is 17039360 (constant is correct at benchbox/core/tpch/benchmark.py:30-32).
(e) Makefile engine drift: Makefile:413-440 pg-extensions test targets hardcode `docker compose` while sibling targets use $(CONTAINER_ENGINE); also document the CONTAINER_ENGINE (make) vs BENCHBOX_CONTAINER_CLI (env) split so operators set both or one derives from the other.
(f) scripts/uat-bring-up/uat_bring_up.py:135-138: a failed standalone bring-up leaves the partial stack up (returns without down) - document the behavior (debugging aid) or add an opt-in --down-on-fail.
(g) volume-reuse provenance: deterministic compose project names + docker_platform_switch containers/off reattach prior-run named volumes with no provenance mark (docker_assets.py:426-437, execute.py:499-541); add a docs note that only 'volumes' mode guarantees fresh data (release-gate configs already use it).

anti_patterns.dont: fix (d) by changing the constant to match the docstring
anti_patterns.why: 17039360 is the correct qgen reference seed; the prose is the bug

anti_patterns.why: P3 sweep = accounting/doc/cosmetic; mixing behavior in makes the diff unreviewable and risks the gate
